```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-init
  namespace: wordsmith
data:
  words.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE nouns (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE verbs (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE adjectives (word TEXT NOT NULL);

    INSERT INTO nouns(word) VALUES
      ('cloud'),
      ('elephant'),
      ('gø language'),
      ('laptøp'),
      ('cøntainer'),
      ('micrø-service'),
      ('turtle'),
      ('whale'),
      ('gøpher'),
      ('møby døck'),
      ('server'),
      ('bicycle'),
      ('viking'),
      ('mermaid'),
      ('fjørd'),
      ('legø'),
      ('flødebolle'),
      ('smørrebrød');

    INSERT INTO verbs(word) VALUES
      ('will drink'),
      ('smashes'),
      ('smøkes'),
      ('eats'),
      ('walks tøwards'),
      ('løves'),
      ('helps'),
      ('pushes'),
      ('debugs'),
      ('invites'),
      ('hides'),
      ('will ship');

    INSERT INTO adjectives(word) VALUES
      ('the exquisite'),
      ('a pink'),
      ('the røtten'),
      ('a red'),
      ('the serverless'),
      ('a brøken'),
      ('a shiny'),
      ('the pretty'),
      ('the impressive'),
      ('an awesøme'),
      ('the famøus'),
      ('a gigantic'),
      ('the gløriøus'),
      ('the nørdic'),
      ('the welcøming'),
      ('the deliciøus');
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
  namespace: wordsmith
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_DB: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-db
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  serviceName: wordsmith-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: db
          image: postgres:10.0-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          volumeMounts:
            - name: init-scripts
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
            limits:
              memory: "256Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
      volumes:
        - name: init-scripts
          configMap:
            name: wordsmith-db-init
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-api
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-api:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: "postgres://wordsmith:wordsmith@wordsmith-db:5432/wordsmith"
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "16Mi"
              cpu: "10m"
            limits:
              memory: "32Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-web
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
  type: LoadBalancer
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-web:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: API_HOST
              value: "wordsmith-api"
            - name: API_PORT
              value: "8080"
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "32Mi"
              cpu: "10m"
            limits:
              memory: "64Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
```
